يتطاعم (form VI)
# يَتَطَاعَمُ (yataṭāʕamu) /ja.ta.tˤaː.ʕa.mu/: third-person masculine singular non-past active indicative of تَطَاعَمَ (taṭāʕama)
# يَتَطَاعَمَ (yataṭāʕama) /ja.ta.tˤaː.ʕa.ma/: third-person masculine singular non-past active subjunctive of تَطَاعَمَ (taṭāʕama)
# يَتَطَاعَمْ (yataṭāʕam) /ja.ta.tˤaː.ʕam/: third-person masculine singular non-past active jussive of تَطَاعَمَ (taṭāʕama
